# BareMetal v1

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's baremetal/v1 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.BareMetalV1(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.baremetal`).

`Nodes.GetVirtualMedia` returns the SDK `VirtualMedia` model with the attached image, insertion state, and media types. See [virtual media reads](nodes/README.md).

`Conductors.Resources` uses `Conductor.Hostname` as both ID and name. `resource.ID("conductor-01")` performs a direct read; `resource.Name("conductor-01")` searches the complete inventory for an exact match. `Drivers.Resources` uses `Driver.Name` as ID and name. Both resources support reads, listing, and name lookup only; deletion and status waits return `ErrUnsupported`. See [conductors](conductors/README.md) and [drivers](drivers/README.md).

Conductor endpoints require microversion 1.49 or later. Configure `sdk.WithMicroversion(sdk.BareMetal, "1.49")` or `sdk.WithMicroversionRange(sdk.BareMetal, "1.49", "latest")`. Calling the operation does not automatically increase the connection version. See [Conductor version requirements and API references](conductors/README.md).

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.BareMetalV1(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Nodes.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Nodes.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
